verses.1: It is good to be poor and humble; it brings peace from the house filled with idols of Rib.
verses.2: A wise servant will rule over his son, and among his brothers, he will divide the inheritance.
verses.3: It is used to make coins and jewelry from gold, and also for making ornaments for the Lord’s temples.
verses.4: May evil listen to the words of a false prophet who lies on the lips of those who are worthy.
verses.5: Let not the ruler be harsh; he who is harsh will never be happy.
verses.6: They honor the elderly with sons, and they adorn their sons with the honors of their fathers.
verses.7: It’s not pleasing to the tongue of those who speak lies, even if they are kind-hearted people who speak truth.
verses.8: Eben-Han, who causes destruction in the eyes of his master, to all those who turn towards him.
verses.9: Hiding one’s sins, seeking love and reconciliation through words that can divide people.
verses.10: Under the anger of those who understand nothing, like a fool.
verses.11: But the wicked will seek evil, and the cruel rulers will send it.
verses.12: Pagoosh Dov Shakul in a man, and Al-Kesil in a woman.
verses.13: May evil be replaced by good. Do not let evil remain in your home.
verses.14: The waters were first divided from each other, before the conflict began.
verses.15: The righteous can also be wicked, and the wicked can also be righteous. Both can cause harm to Jehovah’s laws.
verses.16: Why does a fool try to acquire wisdom and a wise heart?
verses.17: At all times, the enemy loves his enemy; and he lives in harm.
verses.18: A heartless man will always be at a disadvantage before his enemy.
verses.19: He loves sin; he loves evil. He opens his mouth to speak lies.
verses.20: A stubborn heart will never find what’s good; it will instead turn into something bad.
verses.21: A fool will be born, but he will not be happy. His father will be a wicked man.
verses.22: A happy heart is a blessing; a sad spirit will be destroyed.
verses.23: The righteous shall take away from the wicked their places in judgment.
verses.24: The eyes of the wise are like those of a fool, who is located at the edge of the earth.
verses.25: Anger at his father, a child of ignorance and foolishness.
verses.26: It is also not good for the righteous to punish those who are generous.
verses.27: He who hears his words knows the wisdom of a person with noble heart.
verses.28: Even a wise fox will think carefully before speaking.
